question: Who received the Ramsar Award for Wetland Wise Use?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jaishree Venkatesan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jayshree Vencatesan received the Ramsar Award for Wetland Wise Use.
 
• She is the co-founder of Care Earth Trust.
 
• She is also the first Indian to win this award, recognizing her decades of work in preserving India's wetlands, particularly the Pallikaranai Marsh in Chennai.
